description: Make the dashboard truly live for the presentation: rework all 16 dashboard pages under frontend/app/(dashboard)/ so LIVE backend data (the seeded/ingested Forest Season Resort data) is the source of truth, not the baked-in *Snapshot.json fixtures. Either remove the static snapshot fallbacks or keep them only as an explicit offline fallback that never masks a working backend, with tidy loading/empty/error states for a live demo. Depends on FEAT-001 (resort data) and benefits from FEAT-002 (Bearer token attach already handled there).
steps: Inventory the snapshot usage: for each page in frontend/app/(dashboard)/ (page.tsx at root plus market-radar, market-radar/unmapped-categories, time-machine, what-if, playbook, gap-finder, destination, checkout-shield, complaints, guest-compass, concierge, benchmark, authenticity, briefing, forecast, proof-of-impact, review-replies) find where it imports a *Snapshot.json from @/lib and where it calls api.* in a useEffect. Note the current pattern: snapshot as initial state, overwritten by live data, silently falling back to snapshot on error (see market-radar/page.tsx 'live' badge).

Decide the live-first contract: establish a small shared pattern (e.g. a hook or helper in frontend/lib/) for load states so every page: shows a loading state on first paint, renders LIVE API data as the source of truth once loaded, shows a tidy empty state if the backend returns no data, and shows a clear error state (not a silent snapshot) if the backend is unreachable. If snapshots are retained at all, they must be an EXPLICIT, clearly-labelled offline fallback that only engages when the API genuinely cannot be reached, and must never mask a working-but-empty backend. Prefer removing the snapshot imports where the live endpoint fully covers the page.

Rework each dashboard page to the live-first contract. For pages that already fetch live data (e.g. market-radar), remove the snapshot as the default source and drive from the live response, keeping the 'Live from API' badge semantics honest. For pages still rendering primarily from a *Snapshot.json, replace with the matching api.* call(s) from frontend/lib/api.ts (api.heatmap, api.board, api.sentinelMetrics, api.complaints, api.reviewCounts, api.trends, api.decomposition, api.changepoints, api.playbook, api.gapFinder, api.whatIfModel/project, api.timeMachine, api.benchmark, api.authenticity, api.forecast, api.impact, api.briefing, api.guestCompassStays/Metrics/recommendations, api.conciergeFacts/Metrics/message). Confirm each page shows the ingested Forest Season Resort data.

Clean up now-unused snapshot fixtures: if a *Snapshot.json under frontend/lib/ is no longer imported anywhere after the rework, remove it (and any now-dead imports). If kept as an explicit offline fallback, leave a short code comment explaining it is offline-only. Do not break the Vitest tests that may reference these (deep-pages.test.tsx, sentinel-destination-pages.test.tsx) - update them to the new contract.
Keep loading/empty/error states presentation-tidy: use the existing components/ui primitives (Card, Badge, StatTile, PageHeader) and theme so states look intentional, not broken, during a live demo.

Update/extend frontend Vitest tests to the live-first contract: tests should assert pages render live API data (mock api.* to return resort-shaped data) and handle loading/empty/error. Update frontend/app/(dashboard)/deep-pages.test.tsx and sentinel-destination-pages.test.tsx accordingly. Add at least one test asserting a page shows an error/empty state instead of silently showing stale snapshot data when the API fails.

VERIFY: `cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build` all green with the updated route count. Then confirm the data contract end-to-end in-process: `cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed` and a TestClient(app) heredoc hitting every endpoint the dashboard pages consume (/market-radar/review-counts, /market-radar/analytics/trends, /market-radar/analytics/decomposition, /market-radar/analytics/changepoints, /market-radar/analytics/playbook, /market-radar/analytics/gap-finder, /market-radar/analytics/benchmark, /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /sentinel/complaints, /destination/heatmap, /guest-compass/stays, /guest-compass/metrics, /concierge/facts, /concierge/metrics, /minimal/impact, /minimal/forecast, /minimal/authenticity) returns HTTP 200 with resort-populated data, so the live pages will render real content.
acceptance_criteria: Every dashboard page renders LIVE backend data as the source of truth; no page silently masks a working backend with a baked-in snapshot.
Any retained *Snapshot.json is an explicit, clearly-labelled offline-only fallback with a code comment; snapshots no longer used anywhere are removed along with dead imports.
Each page shows tidy loading, empty, and error states using the shared UI primitives/theme (an unreachable backend shows an error/empty state, not stale snapshot data).
The dashboard visibly shows The Forest Season Resort data on the relevant pages (market-radar counts, sentinel board, destination heatmap, concierge facts, playbook/what-if, etc.).
Frontend gates green: npm run lint + npx vitest run (updated tests included) + npm run build; the endpoints every page consumes return HTTP 200 with resort data in the in-process TestClient check.
verification: cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build
cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed

cd backend && uv run python - <<'PY'
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
c=TestClient(app)
eps=['/market-radar/review-counts','/market-radar/analytics/trends','/market-radar/analytics/decomposition','/market-radar/analytics/changepoints','/market-radar/analytics/playbook','/market-radar/analytics/gap-finder','/market-radar/analytics/benchmark','/sentinel/board','/sentinel/metrics','/sentinel/complaints','/destination/heatmap','/guest-compass/stays','/guest-compass/metrics','/concierge/facts','/concierge/metrics','/minimal/impact','/minimal/forecast','/minimal/authenticity']
for p in eps:
    r=c.get(p); print(p, r.status_code, 'ok' if r.status_code==200 else r.text[:120])
PY
findings:
Established a shared live-first load-state pattern: new frontend/lib/useLiveData.ts hook (status loading|ready|empty|error, isEmpty predicate, deps-driven refetch, reload()) and new frontend/components/common/LoadState.tsx (tidy loading skeleton + empty + error panels built from the Card/Button primitives, plus a liveBadgeProps() helper that drives an honest header pill: 'Live from API' / 'Live · no data' / 'Backend unavailable' / 'Loading…'). An unreachable backend now shows the error panel and never leaks data; a working-but-empty backend shows a distinct empty panel.

Reworked ALL 16 dashboard pages to drive from live api.* as the source of truth: root overview page.tsx (now live reviewCounts+sentinelMetrics+board aggregates instead of '—' placeholders), market-radar, market-radar/unmapped-categories, what-if (platform-keyed live model + live project endpoint; dropped the local-projection snapshot shim), time-machine (live decomposition series + live time-machine investigate; home property derived from live reviewCounts), playbook, gap-finder, benchmark, destination (filter-keyed live heatmap), checkout-shield (live board, 4s poll via reload()), complaints (live complaints+metrics, mutations call reload), guest-compass (live stays+metrics+recs, mutations reload), concierge (live facts+metrics; removed the fabricated offline 'naive grounding' answer that masked an unreachable backend — now surfaces an honest chat error), authenticity, briefing (loads live on mount, Regenerate button re-runs), forecast, proof-of-impact (live impact results, log-intervention mutation reloads), and review-replies (removed the fabricated offline template-reply/approve fallbacks; errors now surfaced honestly).

Snapshots: removed ALL 9 now-unused fixtures (git rm) — analyticsSnapshot.json, authenticitySnapshot.json, briefingSnapshot.json, conciergeSnapshot.json, forecastSnapshot.json, guestCompassSnapshot.json, impactSnapshot.json, marketRadarSnapshot.json, sentinelSnapshot.json — and every snapshot import + dead localProjection code. No snapshot is retained; grep for 'Snapshot' across app/lib/components is empty. demoCredentials.ts (login) was untouched and is not a dashboard snapshot.

States: loading = spinner + pulse skeleton Card; empty = Card with a view-specific message (e.g. 'No in-house stays', 'No complaints yet'); error = 'Backend unavailable' Card with a Retry button wired to reload(). Header badge tone/label reflects the live status.

Tests: rewrote deep-pages.test.tsx (7 tests) and sentinel-destination-pages.test.tsx (4 tests) to the live-first contract — they mock api.* to return Forest-Season-shaped payloads via a getter-based module mock, assert LIVE data renders (findByText after fetch resolves), and each file includes a failure test asserting an API rejection shows the 'Backend unavailable' error state with NO stale/snapshot data leaking (queryByText('market gap') / queryByText(/Room 201/) absent). Vitest 20→22 pass. Note: the overall frontend test total is 22 (6 files); lint clean; build 22 routes.

VERIFIED: frontend npm run lint clean, npx vitest run 22 pass, npm run build 22 routes. Backend uv run ruff check . clean, uv run pytest 255 pass. In-process TestClient after `python -m app.seed`: all 18 dashboard endpoints return HTTP 200 with resort-populated data.
